method: KEYFRAME-FIRST: refs, then a free Nano Banana still per beat, then Frames to Video on Veo 3.1 Lite from each still. Motion + sound prompts only.
cast: a son in his 30s and his mother in her 60s
setting_basis: A morning at home, then the empty paved yatra path with metal railings in forested hills, a pony on the path and a blank yatra card in hand; no deity, sanctum, temple interior or crowd is shown, and the footage makes no distance, time or rule claim of its own.
look: Soft natural light, natural colour, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, photorealistic, cinematic. Faces are never in close-up and no one looks at the camera. A phone screen is only a soft glow, never legible. No other people. No music, no speech, no voiceover, no text, captions, logos or watermark.

en: When my cousin's family got back from Vaishno Devi in June, Maa asked why we never went.
I had postponed it once for work, and now she took our stairs slowly.
Then NakshIQ laid the route out: thirteen kilometres from Katra, five to eight hours on foot.
Ponies and palkis run on the traditional route, and a helicopter covers part of it.
Every pilgrim needs the free RFID yatra card, so we collected ours in Katra first.

We went in November, a best month on its list, and Maa rode a pony while I walked.
Travel intelligence is turning a worry into a plan.
NakshIQ.
hi: जून में जब मेरे कज़िन का परिवार वैष्णो देवी से लौटा, तो माँ ने पूछा कि हम क्यों नहीं गए।
काम की वजह से मैं एक बार टाल चुका था, और अब वो घर की सीढ़ियाँ धीरे-धीरे चढ़ती थीं।
फिर NakshIQ ने पूरा रास्ता खोलकर रखा: कटरा से तेरह किलोमीटर, पैदल पाँच से आठ घंटे।
पुराने रास्ते पर घोड़े और पालकी चलते हैं, और कुछ हिस्से के लिए हेलीकॉप्टर भी है।
हर यात्री को मुफ़्त RFID यात्रा कार्ड चाहिए, तो हमने पहले कटरा में ही ले लिया।

हम नवंबर में गए, जो उसकी लिस्ट के सबसे अच्छे महीनों में है, और माँ घोड़े पर चलीं, मैं पैदल।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है फ़िक्र को प्लान में बदलना।
NakshIQ.

shot_notes: Morning at the Katra base: a son in his 30s and his mother in her 60s stand at the start of the stone path, seen from behind.
Close on the son's hand holding two blank plastic yatra cards on a lanyard, nothing legible.
The mother sits on a calm pony on an empty, railed mountain path while the son walks alongside holding the rein, shot from the side.
Their feet on wide stone steps with a metal handrail, morning light across the path.
The two pause at a railing looking across forested hills, backs to camera.
Wide shot of the empty winding path climbing the hillside in morning light, the two small figures on it.
